up: Retrieve all activity records associated with the assay having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1613886. For each activity record, return the compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), the standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, and the pchembl value. Include every activity record without any additional filtering. Do not limit or rank the results.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613886';
